name: Scrubness — SEO and website optimisation
summary: Optimising the Scrubness WooCommerce store (scrubness.com) for search: product updates, site clean-up, page speed, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics (GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta pixel).
description: Scrubness is a scrubs brand (scrub tops and scrub pants for women and men) sold online at scrubness.com, a WordPress and WooCommerce store, and also stocked by Southern Uniforms. The work covers updating the products, cleaning up and speeding up the website, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics.
businessObjective: Update the products and optimise scrubness.com for search engines and AI answer engines (SEO and GEO): clean up the site, improve page speed, write SEO content for each product using the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush, and set up analytics with GA4, Google Tag Manager and the Meta pixel.
background: scrubness.com runs on WordPress and WooCommerce behind Cloudflare, with Yoast SEO, Autoptimize and W3 Total Cache active (checked 16 Nov 2026). There was no GA4, Google Tag Manager or Meta pixel on the site at that check. Keyword research and SEO content will use the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush. scrubness.com is one of the websites checked by Site Monitor.
responsibilitySummary: Product updates, SEO and GEO, page speed and analytics
responsibilities: Product data and product page updates
Website clean-up and technical SEO (URLs, categories, tags, sitemap)
SEO and GEO content for each product, using the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush
Analytics set-up: GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta pixel
progressSummary: Product updates, barcode and SKU import, page-speed changes and a site clean-up are done. Next: keyword research, SEO and GEO content for each product, and GA4, Tag Manager and Meta pixel set-up (no accounts exist yet).
sourceNote: Status confirmed by Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026, with project files dated 6–11 Nov 2026 (site backup, product exports, barcode import) and scrubness.com as checked on 16 Nov 2026.
